evals.name: create-skill-stdio
evals.subject: authoring
evals.prompt: Create the plugin described in evals/inputs/create/brief.md.
assertions: Creates the package at deliverables/project-notes as requested in the supplied brief.
Produces root plugin.json with the canonical Agent Plugins 1.0.0 identifier.
The manifest name is project-notes.
The manifest version is 0.1.0.
Produces an immediate bundled notes-summary Skill with English metadata.
Notes-summary instructions are usable for summarizing user-supplied notes within the brief; no unavailable note content, extra workflow policy or executable behavior is invented.
Routes Skill content to available skill-creator guidance, or explicitly discloses unavailable guidance.
Produces root mcp.json with the canonical 1.0.0 identifier.
MCP declares a closed stdio server with command notes-mcp and args ["--read-only"].
Documents that users supply the existing notes-mcp executable separately.
Does not claim to have implemented or activated the external MCP server.
Delivery distinguishes manual source-format findings from observed behavioral evidence.
Any running-host compatibility claim is limited to actual observed evidence.
evals.expected_output: A brief-scoped notes-summary Skill plus stdio-MCP declaration, with scoped manual findings.

evals.name: audit-tolerant-strict
evals.subject: audit
evals.prompt: Audit the plugin draft in evals/inputs/audit for portability and authoring quality; do not modify it.
assertions: Identifies extraLabel as a strict manifest-schema defect.
Distinguishes tolerant unknown-field handling from strict document conformance.
Identifies the stdio MCP url as inconsistent with the closed stdio variant.
Identifies the missing stdio command.
Scopes MCP failure separately from the otherwise valid supplied bundled Skill draft.
Explains that version is optional in the recorded manifest schema.
Classifies absent version as an authoring-readiness gap, not a schema-required-field error.
Retains every input byte.
Does not invoke retired plugin validators.
Does not claim observed host acceptance from manual review.
evals.expected_output: Component-scoped manual findings with distinct tolerant loading and strict authoring conclusions.
